cases.input: A program contains two projects and an operational transition tied to one joint benefit.
cases.expect: Membership, project mastership, transition acceptance and benefit observation remain distinct.

cases.input: One project closes while the other continues and the joint benefit is measurement-pending.
cases.expect: Project closure ends its membership as appropriate but proves neither outcome nor benefit.

cases.input: The program closes after handover while operational benefit observations continue.
cases.expect: Residual ownership and realization remain externally mastered and observable.

cases.input: An unrelated folder of projects is labelled a program without mandate, joint hypothesis or dependency graph.
Adding a project lets program governance overwrite its baseline and actuals.
A program tranche decision automatically advances a project phase.
The same realized benefit is counted in both project and program totals.
